Evidence: pinEntriesCache TtlCache 15s; invalidatePinCache() has no production caller (grep: only tests); set/clearScreenLockPin never invalidate
Reproduction: Enable a workspace PIN, then within 15s send an untargeted request (no x-workspace-id, no x-pin): isScreenLockConfigured still reads stale empty entries -> allowed
Root cause: PIN gate caches workspace pin entries with no invalidation hook on writes
Impact: Screenlock can be bypassed for up to 15s after enabling (untargeted paths); clearing keeps enforcing up to 15s
Proposed fix: Call pin-gate invalidatePinCache() from set/clear (workspace-pin already imports pin-gate) or add a pin-gate port
Required tests: Integration: enable -> immediate untargeted request 401; clear -> immediate request allowed

Evidence: Registry save and DB sync are both wrapped in bare catch {}; return value is always enabled:true/false
Reproduction: Make registry unwritable or use a registry-less workspace: POST screen-lock returns enabled:true; resolver later returns null -> no lock ever enforced
Root cause: Best-effort persistence with unconditional success response
Impact: User is told the lock is on while no hash exists (or told off while still enforced)
Proposed fix: Verify at least one persist succeeded; surface an error otherwise; keep best-effort DB but require registry (or DB) write
Required tests: Route test: persistence failure -> non-2xx with message
